title: test(electron): cover Windows path normalization
body:
## Summary / 摘要

Add direct regression coverage for the Windows path-normalization contract across the `LinkIndex` lifecycle.

## Motivation / 背景与动机

- Related issue: #77
- Complements #79 without touching the sample-vault fixture assertions.
- `LinkIndex` stores and returns forward-slash paths on every platform, but its unit tests previously used POSIX-style inputs almost exclusively. Direct Windows-style inputs make that production contract explicit and keep future changes to rebuild and incremental mutations from reintroducing separator-dependent behavior.
- Roadmap: N/A
- OpenSpec change: N/A (test-only change)

## Changes / 变更内容

- `apps/electron-demo`: add four end-to-end `LinkIndex` regression cases covering rebuild/resolve/backlinks, mixed-separator updates, removal, and rename behavior.
- No production code, public API, fixture, or dependency changes.

## Testing / 测试

- [x] Full Vitest suite: 34 files, 541 tests passed
- [x] TypeScript `--noEmit` check passed for all 12 workspace tsconfigs
- [x] Electron demo production build passed (`tsup` + `vite build`)
- [x] New cases avoid relying on `Map` insertion order
- [ ] Manual UI check (not applicable: test-only change)
